shared_elements: quadruped animal in profile facing right
horizontal band of repeated motifs (row of discs/loaves above in A, row of rosettes below in B)
repeated animals arranged in a row
justification: Both are stone low reliefs that combine a row of profile quadrupeds with a strip of small repeated motifs running horizontally across the surface, and both include a human-limbed figure adjacent to the animals. But the resemblance stops at these generic conventions: A is shallow, schematic and stacked into loosely aligned registers on a narrow upright block, while B is a single deeply modelled, tightly proportioned processional frieze with fine surface patterning (fleece, hair, rosettes) and a strict groundline.
